result.summary: Re-gate of docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-017.md at HEAD (ae835b0, feature/WF02-REQ-017), following BACKEND-DEV's fix commit d2fa122 (hourCycle: 'h23' added to formatDateTimeInTimezone) and REVIEWER/SECURITY-REVIEWER's re-gates (2420149, ae835b0), both PASS. Read the test spec file independently (unchanged since the original Step 3b review -- confirmed byte-identical: git diff 2a7e576..d2fa122 -- docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-017.md shows only its initial creation, no subsequent edit). The original FAIL was never a spec defect: AC2's and AC5's exact expected time strings (18:00, 20:00, 23:30, 22:45) were correct against the design doc's stated 24-hour mechanism; the bug was the implementation silently defaulting en-US to 12-hour AM/PM because hourCycle was unset. Re-verified by actually running the real, now-fixed formatDateTimeInTimezone (apps/bot/src/i18n/formatTimeInTimezone.ts:26-37, hourCycle: 'h23' present) against the exact instants the spec cites: new Date('2026-10-01T13:00:00Z') in Asia/Tashkent/en -> 'Oct 1, 2026, 18:00' (matches AC2's '18:00' claim byte-for-byte); new Date('2026-10-01T15:00:00Z') -> 'Oct 1, 2026, 20:00' (matches AC2's '20:00'); new Date('2026-10-01T18:30:00Z') -> 'Oct 1, 2026, 23:30' (matches AC5's talk-item '23:30'); new Date('2026-10-01T17:45:00Z') -> 'Oct 1, 2026, 22:45' (matches AC5's doors-item '22:45'). Also spot-checked the midnight boundary REVIEWER's Step 2b re-gate cited (Tashkent 00:00 and 12:00) directly: 2026-10-01T19:00:00Z -> 'Oct 2, 2026, 00:00' and 2026-10-01T07:00:00Z -> 'Oct 1, 2026, 12:00' -- h23 correctly renders midnight as '00:00', never the '24:00' footgun. All four spec exact-value assertions (AC2 x2, AC5 x2) now match the real implementation output exactly; no case in the spec requires restating. Re-checked scope of everything the fix touched: git diff 2a7e576..d2fa122 --stat shows only apps/bot/src/i18n/formatTimeInTimezone.ts (+hourCycle), apps/bot/src/i18n/formatTimeInTimezone.test.ts, and apps/bot/src/domain/event.test.ts (one byproduct AM/PM fixture corrected) -- no handler, domain non-test source, DB query, schema, or migration file changed, so every other previously-passed part of my original review is unaffected and re-confirmed still valid at HEAD: (a) every AC (AC1-AC6) plus AC-cover/AC-catalog has a live grammY-dispatch case via bot.handleUpdate() against a real fixture Postgres, zero mocked Context objects anywhere in the spec; (b) AC2's TZ variance is genuinely applied to the whole process env (TZ=America/New_York vs unset), not just passed as a function parameter -- still the correct live-integration gap the unit test alone can't catch; (c) AC3's updated_at diffing snapshots the events row before and after two separate live reads (deep-link card then /events list) and requires byte-identical values across both, correctly proving computed-not-stored; (d) AC4's git-grep pattern and schema-diff check remain complete and correctly scoped for the unchanged domain/schema files; (e) AC1/AC3/AC6c/AC-catalog's quoted catalog label strings ('Yandex Maps:', 'Google Maps:', 'Seats left:', the followCityInvite sentence) re-checked against the current apps/bot/src/i18n/en.ts and still match verbatim -- these files were not touched by d2fa122; (f) every acceptance criterion (AC1-AC6, plus the two justified extra gap cases) still has >=1 case naming the exact route/dispatch, fixture, timezone, and expected result with no 'TODO' and no judgment-call language ('check it looks right') anywhere in the file. No new coverage gap introduced by the fix -- the fix changed only a formatting detail the spec already specified correctly.
